description: Банк России - DailyInfo (веб-сервис) (market data): search_symbols, get_series. Every tool maps to a

tools.name: search_symbols
tools.description: Currencies quoted daily (EnumValutes, Seld=false): symbol is the CBR code (R01235 = USD), name the English name, type the ISO letter code; the Russian name is raw.Vname. query matches any of them.

tools.name: get_series
tools.description: Official RUB rate per ONE unit of the currency (VunitRate; raw.Vcurs is per Vnom units) for every fixing day from start to end. series_id is the CBR code from search_symbols (R01235 USD, R01239 EUR, R01375 CNY). start and end (YYYY-MM-DD) are both REQUIRED by the service.
